title: 300 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Bali Uluwatu
metaTitle: Bali Yoga School: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaDescription: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali was started with a sole purpose of propagating the higher teachings of yoga and the practice of the traditional forms of yoga.
summary: Building upon your 200-hour foundation, this advanced immersion cultivates a profound understanding essential for guiding students into the rich layers of stillness and release.
intro: Bali Yoga School was founded with a profound purpose: to share the deeper wisdom and authentic traditions of yoga. Our 300 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training, held on the serene cliffs of Uluwatu, Bali, is designed to help you master the subtle, transformative art of Yin. Building upon your 200-hour foundation, this advanced immersion cultivates a profound understanding essential for guiding students into the rich layers of stillness and release.

This program emphasizes advanced Yin teaching methodology, intelligent sequencing for long-held poses, and integrating critical elements like fascial anatomy, meridian theory, Taoist principles, Yin-specific adjustments, meditation for stillness, and therapeutic applications.
Graduates emerge empowered to teach Yin Yoga confidently to all levels – from beginners seeking grounding to advanced practitioners exploring deep release.
durationStatements: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 PM with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 27th of every month at 7:00 Pm, Departure date is 28th of every month before 12:00 Pm afternoon time.

dining.text: A sattvic diet generally includes: fresh, organically grown fruits and vegetables; nuts and whole grains; dairy-based foods (e.g. ghee and milk); lentils; beans; plant-based oils; foods with mild sweetness containing natural and unrefined sugars; spices such as turmeric, ginger, coriander, basil and cinnamon.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 PM with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 27th of every month at 7:00 PM, Departure date is 28th of every month before 12:00 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. Participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes. Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course. Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness one can take leave with the respected teacher's permission. Uninformed leaves won’t be accepted.

policies.title: Discipline Rules
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.
If you are fasting any day, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.
Friends or relatives are not included in accommodation; however they can stay in school by renting another room.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Booking deposit is refundable only when the customer cancels the course more than 15 days before the course starting date. The booking deposit will be refunded after deducting 10% from the deposit as the service charge + bank charge + the government tax. The refund will be initiated within 7 working days upon the request.
If you cancel the course within 15 days from the course starting date, the deposit is not refundable. In this case, we accept date rescheduling.
If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded.

issues: LEGACY / OUTDATED PAGE: all batches are Aug 2024 – May 2025 (past as of capture 2026-10-19); fees use an older format (single USD prices, no discount) and differ from the current Uluwatu Yin price structure.

Despite the Yin title, the syllabus is a 300-hour multistyle syllabus (Hatha/Vinyasa, Ashtanga intermediate series, Ayurveda/therapy); the only Yin syllabus content is the one-line heading 'Yin Asanas + Yin Theory + Yin Alignment / Adjustment / Methodology'. Section heading reads '300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training School Bali - Course Syllabus'.
Meta title 'Bali Yoga School: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali' and meta description are generic multistyle text, not Yin-specific.
Duration consistent: 'Course Duration : 28 Days'; batches 1st–28th (and 4th–31st Jan 2025) = 28 days inclusive; start 1st 5 PM, end 27th, departure 28th; 27 nights accommodation.
No hour calculation shown; '300' only from title/URL/'300 Hours Course Manual'.
